notes:
Mobile UI is now available in the live Android app.

- Larger mobile menus, original PokeFields icons, custom adjustable A/B and D-pad, and smoother control transitions.
- Centered nine-slot hotbar, vertical party panel, native top-right status, and improved inventory controls.
- Resizable chat with working close, lock and transparency; chat stays hidden over menus. Quest tracker lock and emote picker improvements.
- Fixed malformed wallet balances caused by decoding map warp strings incorrectly.
- Corrected battle material color handling, Typhlosion Flamethrower origin, and aligned Switch/Bag/Flee buttons.
- Map Fly uses an eligible party Pokemon and existing server rules.

Install over the existing unofficial app to retain its ROM imports and settings. The separate Mobile Test app remains separate; its data is not automatically migrated. No ROMs are included.

Validation: source and compiled mobile UI regressions, packaged startup, original signing certificate and package identity, retained Android services, and offline ROM battle/effect comparisons. Wallet decoding was also verified on a phone in Test 18. This final release has not been played through on a phone because ADB is currently disconnected.
